title: Rule-based scenario items
summary: Store each item as one rule in scenario.yaml (amount, frequency, start, end); expand to entries at report time so items are editable in one place
notes: Today a weekly item for 24 months writes about 104 entries

title: Cash runway and burn
summary: Start from the real bank balance; monthly cash, burn, runway in months, cash-out month, warning floor (e.g. 3 months of costs)

title: Revenue-linked expenses (gearing)
summary: Item types: % of revenue (fees, commission), per unit (customer/order; revenue = units x price), ratio caps (marketing <= 15% of revenue) with breach flags
notes: User's example: expenses as a factor or divisor of revenue

title: Growth rates and step changes
summary: Revenue growing X%/month; costs stepping up at a date (rent change, raise after N months)

title: Hiring plan
summary: Roles by department with salary, benefits %, start and end month, raise %; expand to monthly payroll and headcount; optional equipment cost per new hire

title: Compare, layer, clone; scenario to budget
summary: Side-by-side Lean/Base/Aggressive (net, burn, runway, break-even); layers (Base + hire + studio move); clone; generate budget YAML from a scenario, which gives web budgeting without a separate editor

title: Rolling forecast and plan vs actual
summary: Actuals to date + plan after; monthly variance with largest gaps flagged

title: What-if sliders
summary: Revenue x0.7/1.0/1.3, hire delays, revenue start shift; recompute live without saving

title: Charts and export
summary: Cash-over-time line per scenario in Charts tab; export scenario comparison to spreadsheet

title: Feature switch: setting
summary: global.yaml features: list of enabled extras; missing list = baseline only; baseline list fixed in code

title: Feature switch: pair features command + installer prompt
summary: pair features list|enable|disable; installer asks which extras to turn on

title: Feature switch: CLI gate
summary: pair checks the list before dispatching a MODULE_MAP command; disabled = hint message, module never imported

title: Feature switch: web gate
summary: /api/features endpoint; Plan tab shown only when enabled; scenario endpoints 404 when off

title: Feature switch: budget --scenario gated
summary: budget vs/forecast --scenario offered only when scenarios enabled

title: Rebase PR #1 onto feature switch
summary: Land I10-I14 as their own PR, then rebase PR #1 so scenarios is the first opt-in feature

title: PR #1 housekeeping
summary: Linear ticket, [NA-xxx] PR title, remove the feature worktree worktree after merge

title: Company profile per entity
summary: Profile section in entity config: founders, stage, business type, team size, founding year, industry, TAM, market share, exit multiple, status real|speculative; editable in web

title: Metrics framework
summary: Metric catalogue (bucket, unit, kind flow/stock/ratio, source manual/ledger/derived) + monthly values per entity; web grid for manual entry; optional starting/current column; add custom metrics into buckets

title: Ledger-derived and formula metrics
summary: Auto-fill revenue, COGS, burn, cash, runway from hledger; derived ARR, margins, growth, LTV:CAC, cost per lead

title: Metric gearing / projection
summary: Project metrics forward from the starting column with a factor per line or per group (growth %/mo or multiplier); master trajectory view
notes: Same idea as I03/I04 applied to metrics

title: Speculative companies
summary: Entity kind speculative: profile + scenarios + metrics + cap table versions, no real journal required

title: Burn & Runway module
summary: Standalone report: begin/end cash, net burn, average burn, breakeven, runway; inputs manual or ledger actuals + scenario for future months; Sources & Uses raise planner

title: Reporting categories and stage bands
summary: Map ledger accounts to report categories (Salaries; Marketing; Product; Legal & Accounting; Overhead) and optional stage bands (Startup/Seed/Growth) for quarterly summaries

title: Financing inflows in scenarios
summary: Scenario items for equity, convertible note/SAFE, debt and grants: affect cash and runway, not P&L; funding entered once feeds cash + cap table

title: Cap table register
summary: Holders, share classes, issuances, option pool and grants, instruments (notes/SAFEs with discount, cap, interest, dates); current table derived from register; links to cash journal entries

title: Cap table versions (contemplated rounds)
summary: Versions = current table + hypothetical rounds; each round has investment by investor class (founders, friends & family, angel/seed, Series A-D) and adds common, preferred and options; pre-money or % sold, pool top-up, note/SAFE conversions; outputs price, shares, %, fully diluted, $ value by holder; compare versions

title: CAC / LTV allocation
summary: CAC from allocated acquisition cost / new paying customers; LTV from cohort retention x revenue per user; LTV:CAC and payback as derived metrics (not a standalone sheet)

title: Profile links and documents
summary: Pitch deck, one-pager, data room and other links on the profile

title: Executive pack
summary: Group profile, cap table and rounds, runway, KPIs and company portrait as the core executive views (an opt-in pack)

title: Growth engine: channel models
summary: Channels produce new users per period: paid (spend -> impressions -> CTR -> conversion; CPA), viral/referral (invites x conversion), organic/content (traffic growth x conversion), sales capacity (reps x quota x ramp), partners (partners x users each); spend becomes scenario expense

title: Funnel stages
summary: Configurable stages (visitor -> signup -> active -> paying) with conversion rates; all channels feed one funnel

title: Cohort retention
summary: Each period's new users form a cohort that decays by a retention curve (not just a flat rate); logo and revenue retention; expansion for net revenue retention

title: Revenue per user and contribution
summary: Revenue mix by tier/plan -> revenue per paying user; cost to serve per user; contribution after acquisition = revenue - acquisition spend - cost to serve

title: Projected three statements
summary: Income statement, balance sheet and cash flow: actuals from the books, projection from scenarios; drivers for working-capital days, equipment and depreciation, debt and interest, tax loss carryforward
notes: P&L and cash done (P6); balance sheet projection not built

title: Company portrait
summary: One ordered page telling the company's story: profile -> team -> revenue -> margins -> spending -> profit -> cash and runway -> funding and ownership -> valuation; each section reads from its module

title: Valuation methods
summary: Early-stage friendly: VC method, comparables, scorecard; DCF/WACC optional

title: Minimum cash policy and credit line
summary: Minimum cash = N months of payroll (or fixed); warn or auto-draw a credit line in projections

title: Per-product revenue lines
summary: Units x price per product line with unit COGS, margin and growth per line

title: MRR bridge
summary: Monthly new, expansion, contraction and churned MRR plus active customers

title: Investor pipeline (CRM)
summary: Investors as contacts (organization, investor type, referral source); a deal per investor per round with stage, first/last meeting, amount, next step and meeting notes; board view by stage

title: Commitments and round close
summary: Soft/hard circled and closed amounts vs round target; closing a commitment creates the cash funding entry and the cap-table issuance in one step

title: Rounds register
summary: Round: name, type, instrument (note, SAFE, equity), target, anticipated close, terms; shared by pipeline, cap-table versions and scenario funding

title: Raise calculator
summary: Raise target = projected burn x buffer months (editable, default 15) with the reason shown; compare to Sources & Uses and runway

title: Momentum metrics and investor updates
summary: Count connections, meetings and conversions per month from the pipeline; keep every contacted investor (incl. declined) on an updates list

title: Credit line in projections
summary: Draw a credit line automatically when cash would fall below the floor, repay when cash allows, with interest
notes: Floor warning exists; auto-draw not built

title: Exit waterfall and liquidation preferences
summary: Exit value -> proceeds per holder: preference multiple, participating or not, seniority, conversion to common when better

title: Vesting and pro-rata
summary: Vesting schedules (cliff, monthly) on grants and founder shares; pro-rata rights in versions

title: Investor classes and contact links
summary: Holder groups for friends & family, angels, funds; pipeline investors linked to contact records

title: Investor updates list
summary: Everyone contacted (including passed) as an updates audience; export or copy list; last-update date

title: CAC allocation by category
summary: % of each report category counted as acquisition cost -> computed CAC from the books

title: Stage bands
summary: Date ranges (startup, seed, growth) to total spending by company stage

title: Traction vs ownership chart
summary: One chart: chosen traction metric, founder ownership and cash over time

title: Runway what-if sliders
summary: Revenue x, cost x, hire delay, revenue start shift on Runway (preview only)

title: KPI starting column and unit retention
summary: Optional starting/current month column in the KPI grid; retention factor on per-product unit lines
